Create a full-length photorealistic historical-fashion editorial: a rain-bright Art Deco ferry-terminal scene built around a qipao silhouette. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a silk qipao with a high standing collar, a diagonal right-front opening secured by handmade frog closures, a fitted calf-length body, and controlled side slits that reveal construction while she walks. She steps across a wet geometric-glass threshold while rotating one brass timetable card with her fingertips, freezing the fabric between stillness and stride. Keep collar, diagonal fastening line, waist shaping, hem, and one slit simultaneously readable. Use full-body three-quarter framing, rain reflections, period brass and glass details, natural skin texture, and crisp side light softened by mist.
